messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=runtime-inference p99 latency = 1.85s (> alert 1.2s). Alert ID PD-90812.
PagerDuty: Automated page sent to on-call.
Lee: Acked. I'm on it, looking at regional dashboards.
Maria: Noticed tail on eu-west, p95 creeping too. Any recent rollouts?
Sam: No deploys in last 30m. Telemetry shows a spike of large-batched requests from a few customers.
Lee: Tracing into hot hosts... kvcache miss rate jumped ~10x. Might be a cache-eviction storm.
Katie: Quick mitigation idea: enable fallthrough routing to dedicated pool and throttle batching for 10m. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maria: +1 to routing fallback. Also can we temporarily lower max_batch_size from 64 -> 16 for the public pool?
Lee: Doing that now. Command: ```rctl scale --pool public-inference --batch-max=16 --timeout=30s```
Sam: Pushing routing change to divert 20% to dedicated: ```curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/override -d '{"route":"runtime-inference","fallback":"dedicated-eu","percent":20}'```
incident-bot: Change detected: routing override applied by Sam.
Lee: kvcache eviction metrics stabilizing on a few hosts. p99 down to 1.2s (from 1.85). Still above target but trending.
Maria: Customer-impact estimate? Any errors or timeouts?
Sam: No increase in 5xxs, only latency. Affected customers: approx 7 customers (high token workloads) — notif sent to SEs.
Katie: Logged a temporary SLO incident note in runbook: https://runbook.internal/slo-p95-incident #PD-90812
Lee: Will keep monitoring for 15m. If p99 doesn't drop below 1.1s, escalate to SRE lead and consider full coldstart-kv warmup.
Maria: Noting mitigation: reduced batch size + 20% routing. Also we warmed a couple of caches with synthetic prefixes.
Sam: Telemetry now: p95 = 320ms, p99 = 980ms. Good improvement.
Lee: Nice work. I will prepare a short post-incident summary for rotation handoff.
Katie: On-call rotation for next window: @Sam takes over in 30m. Please document exact changes in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
Sam: Acked handoff. I'll keep an eye for 1 hour.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-90812 acknowledged by Lee.
PagerDuty: Incident resolved? None yet — monitoring.
Lee: Closing loop for now; leaving routing override active for 10m to ensure stability, then rollback if steady.
Maria: If anyone needs the rollback command: ```curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/override -d '{"route":"runtime-inference","rollback":true}'```
Sam: Will attach graphs and TTLs to the ticket. Great triage team.
Katie: Leaving a short note for postmortem: root cause suspected kvcache eviction under a burst of large-batched requests; mitigations were routing fallback + reduce batch size + synthetic warmup.
Lee: End of thread — monitoring continues.
